system.description: Action during a conflict: a free attack with an equipped two-handed ranged thrown custom weapon, gaining multi (2) — still enhanceable to 3 by Barrage. If it hits, you may send the weapon spinning. At the start of your turn, if it is still spinning, it stops and you choose up to two: every enemy you can see loses 5 HP; or loses 5 MP; or suffers slow; or fill or erase 1 section of a Clock. HP and MP losses rise to 10 at level 30+. It stops spinning at once if you unequip it, attack with it again, or the scene ends. The Clock option is conflict Clocks only, settled in the Clock-effects sweep.
